items.author: Burry
items.text: ‘Big Short’ Michael Burry calls Nvidia a ‘heck of a trade’ but questions its long-term future
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Michael Burry称英伟达是一笔“很棒的交易”，但质疑其长期前景，呈现短线认可与长期谨慎并存的观点。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk's Tesla and SpaceX lose over $420 billion in combined market cap after midterms
items.summary_cn: 据报道，美国中期选举后特斯拉与SpaceX合计市值蒸发逾4200亿美元，反映市场对马斯克相关资产的短线情绪显著转弱。

items.author: Pelosi
items.text: Nancy Pelosi’s Warner Bros. Stake Was Cashed Out in Paramount Deal, Worth About 43% of Her Salary
items.summary_cn: 最新国会披露显示，Pelosi持有的Warner Bros. Discovery股份因Paramount交易套现，价值约相当于其年薪的43%，交易重点是并购结算而非看空。

items.author: Musk
items.text: US SEC seeks to close Musk, Tesla settlement fund
items.summary_cn: 据报道，美国证监会寻求关闭马斯克与特斯拉相关的和解资金安排，构成对特斯拉合规及治理的负面监管信号。

items.author: Burry
items.text: Michael Burry Says Jensen’s Affair Won’t Sink Nvidia, But Regulators Might
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Michael Burry认为黄仁勋的私人丑闻不会拖垮英伟达，但相关监管风险仍可能对英伟达构成压力。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk says Tesla will extend Cybertruck production through end of summer
items.summary_cn: 据报道，马斯克表示特斯拉Cybertruck生产将延长至夏末结束，有助于缓解停产疑虑并支持近期交付。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Germany's Isar Aerospace eyes overtaking Elon Musk's SpaceX
items.summary_cn: 据报道，德国Isar Aerospace正寻求在商业航天领域超越马斯克的SpaceX，显示欧洲航天竞争者带来的长期压力。

items.author: 段永平
items.text: 交易所透明度，不應被簡化為一個“可信”標籤
items.summary_cn: 相关评论主张交易所透明度不应被简化为单一“可信”标签，提示加密交易平台的信任与合规标准仍可能影响行业发展。

items.author: Trump
items.text: I had an excellent conversation with Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani, the Prime Minister of Qatar, wherein much was discussed with respect to the Islamic Republic of Iran. Most importantly, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Bahrain, Kuwait, and others, would prefer the status quo, in other words, a continuation of the Greatest Naval Blockade in History, and the new Operation Iron Gate — Therefore, Land and Sea. items.summary_cn: 特朗普称卡塔尔及海湾国家支持延续对伊朗的海上封锁并推动“铁门行动”，显示中东冲突与能源供应风险仍高。

items.author: Trump
items.text: I am proud to announce that David MacNeil, the GREAT American entrepreneur and founder of WeatherTech, will be the Special Envoy for Manufacturing! David has built an incredible American company that makes outstanding products, RIGHT HERE IN THE U.S.A. He knows how to create jobs, bring Manufacturing back home, and put America First. Together, we will bring back American jobs, strengthen our factories, and make sure that future products are MADE IN AMERICA. Congratulations David — Your unparalleled expertise is vitally needed! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普任命WeatherTech创始人David MacNeil为制造业特使，释放强化美国本土制造与就业的政策信号。
